desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth.translation: 與它的另一端相連。以奇異物質維持；耗盡時會關閉並等待補充。首次放置時，無需燃料也會保持開啟 5 分鐘。

desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth_casing.source: An open frame that holds a stabilized throat. One per wormhole mouth.
desc.singulo.wormhole_mouth_casing.translation: 容納已穩定喉部的開放式框架。每個蟲洞入口需要一個。

desc.singulo.wormhole_port.source: Within 8 blocks of a mouth, links machines to the port with the same number (0-127) near the twin mouth. A mouth runs 8, 32 or 128 ports by throat size, nearest first. Glows while active.
desc.singulo.wormhole_port.translation: 在入口 8 格內時，把機器連接到另一端入口附近編號相同（0-127）的埠。每個入口依喉部大小可讓 8、32 或 128 個埠運作，依距離由近到遠。運作時會發光。

desc.singulo.wormhole_stabilizer.source: Stabilizes an unstable wormhole mouth with exotic matter so that it can be placed.
desc.singulo.wormhole_stabilizer.translation: 以奇異物質穩定不穩定蟲洞入口，使其成為可以放置的入口。

desc.singulo.zero_gravity_block.source: When powered by a panel receiver, the space above it (5 blocks at first) becomes weightless: hold jump to drift up, sneak to drift down, and there is no fall damage. 30 FE/t each. A zero-gravity control box changes the height. Joins visually with its neighbours.
desc.singulo.zero_gravity_block.translation: 由面板受電器供電時，上方的空間（初始為5格）會變成無重力。在其中按跳躍鍵向上、潛行向下漂浮，也不會受到摔落傷害。每個30 FE/t。高度可用無重力控制箱改變。與相鄰的同種方塊外觀相連。

desc.singulo.zero_gravity_controller.source: Attached to zero-gravity blocks, it sets the weightless height for all the joined blocks (right-click to raise it by one, sneak-right-click to lower it; no limit). Each extra block of height multiplies the power of every zero-gravity block by 1.6.
desc.singulo.zero_gravity_controller.translation: 裝在無重力方塊上後，可改變相連的全部無重力方塊的無重力高度（右鍵升高1格，潛行右鍵降低，沒有上限）。高度每增加1格，每個無重力方塊的耗電變為1.6倍。

ending.singulo.archivist.source: — The Archivist's voice: "Beyond the last page. Thank you for letting me read it."
ending.singulo.archivist.translation: ——記錄者的聲音傳來：「最後一頁的，那之後。謝謝你讓我讀到它。」

ending.singulo.line.1.source: Once, a civilization tried to turn all mass into energy.
ending.singulo.line.1.translation: 曾經，有一個文明，想把所有的質量都化為能量。

ending.singulo.line.2.source: The reactor granted that wish: the cities, the mountains, the sea. Only the anomaly and the records remained.
ending.singulo.line.2.translation: 爐實現了那個願望。城市、山巒、海洋，盡皆如此。留下的，只有重力的異常與記錄。

ending.singulo.line.3.source: You read those records and lit the same fire. And you never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
ending.singulo.line.3.translation: 你讀了那些記錄，在同樣的爐中點起了火。而你，始終沒有放開那隻停止投料的手。

ending.singulo.line.4.source: And now the energy has become mass again, then stars, then a galaxy.
ending.singulo.line.4.translation: 而此刻，能量重新化為質量，化為星辰，化為銀河。

ending.singulo.line.5.source: Look up at the night sky. That light is the universe you made.
ending.singulo.line.5.translation: 請抬頭仰望夜空。那道光，就是你所孕育的宇宙。

ending.singulo.supporter_controls.source: ← / → to browse supporters · Esc to close
ending.singulo.supporter_controls.translation: ← / → 瀏覽支持者 · Esc 關閉

entity.singulo.bit_android.translation: 浮游砲型仿生人「諾克絲」

gauntlet.singulo.area.single.translation: 範圍：視線上的單一目標

gui.singulo.anchor.confirm_embed.source: Use again to embed. It cannot be removed
gui.singulo.anchor.confirm_embed.translation: 再次右鍵點擊即可嵌入。嵌入後無法取出

gui.singulo.anchor.limited.translation: 已達到錨的上限（每人 %s 台）

gui.singulo.anchor.status.translation: 半徑 %s 區塊 · %s · %s FE/t · 儲能 %s FE

gui.singulo.android.chem.hint.source: Click with a chemical tank (Mekanism) or similar to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.chem.hint.translation: 用化學品儲罐（Mekanism）等點擊，可放入或取出

gui.singulo.android.decor.0.hint.source: Ribbon, hair flower, beret, headdress or glasses
gui.singulo.android.decor.0.hint.translation: 緞帶、髮飾、貝雷帽、頭飾、眼鏡

gui.singulo.android.decor.2.hint.source: Paperback, bouquet, teacup or umbrella (held only while idle)
gui.singulo.android.decor.2.hint.translation: 文庫本、花束、茶杯、傘（僅在待機時拿著）

gui.singulo.android.decor.dye.source: Dye them with dyes on a crafting table
gui.singulo.android.decor.dye.translation: 可與染料一起在工作台染色

gui.singulo.android.follow.hint.source: Click to switch between "Follow only" (never fights) and "Follow & escort" (fights nearby enemies). Also changes the station setting.
gui.singulo.android.follow.hint.translation: 點擊在「只跟隨」（不戰鬥）和「跟隨·護衛」（與附近的敵人戰鬥）之間切換。組裝站的設定也會一起改變。

gui.singulo.android.log.alarm.source: Spotted a group of %2$s (%1$s and others) and raised the alarm
gui.singulo.android.log.alarm.translation: 發現了 %1$s 等 %2$s 個敵人的群體，發出了警報

gui.singulo.android.log.empty.1.source: Defeated enemies and alarms show up here
gui.singulo.android.log.empty.1.translation: 擊倒的敵人和警報會記在這裡

gui.singulo.android.say.idle.6.source: I'll do my best today too!

gui.singulo.android.sort.hint.source: Sort the carried items and backpack contents (stacks the same items together)
gui.singulo.android.sort.hint.translation: 整理攜帶物品和背包內的物品（相同的物品會合併）

gui.singulo.android.stall.full.source: Storage is full; can't put items away
gui.singulo.android.stall.full.translation: 存放處已滿，無法放下物品

gui.singulo.android.stall.missing.source: Not enough materials in the stockpile
gui.singulo.android.stall.missing.translation: 資材存放處的材料不足

gui.singulo.android.stall.no_power.source: The station is out of power; can't charge
gui.singulo.android.stall.no_power.translation: 組裝站電力不足，無法充電

gui.singulo.android.stall.no_target.source: Nothing to work on in the area right now
gui.singulo.android.stall.no_target.translation: 作業範圍內現在沒有可處理的對象

gui.singulo.android.stall.protected.source: A protected block; can't break it
gui.singulo.android.stall.protected.translation: 方塊受到保護，無法破壞

gui.singulo.android.stash.going.source: Going to put things in a nearby box
gui.singulo.android.stash.going.translation: 去把東西放進附近的箱子

gui.singulo.android.stash.hint.source: Go and put the carried items and backpack contents in a nearby box (chest, barrel, shulker box or supply port)
gui.singulo.android.stash.hint.translation: 把攜帶物品和背包內的物品，放進附近的箱子（箱子、木桶、界伏盒、資材口）

gui.singulo.android.stash.none.source: No box nearby to put things in (within 12 blocks)
gui.singulo.android.stash.none.translation: 附近沒有可以存放的箱子（12 格以內）

gui.singulo.android.tank.hint.source: Click with a bucket or other container to fill or draw
gui.singulo.android.tank.hint.translation: 用桶等容器點擊，可放入或取出

gui.singulo.android.work.hint.source: Whether this android may be given work (automation). When off, it is never offered for work.
gui.singulo.android.work.hint.translation: 是否可以給這個仿生人分配作業（自動化）。關閉後，它不會出現在作業的候選中。

gui.singulo.android_station.escort.hint.source: While following, it also fights enemies near you.
gui.singulo.android_station.escort.hint.translation: 跟隨時也會擊敗你附近的敵人。

gui.singulo.android_station.follow_only..source: While following, it only tags along and never fights (not even when hit).
gui.singulo.android_station.follow_only..translation: 跟隨時只跟著走，不戰鬥（被攻擊也不還手）。

gui.singulo.android_station.leader.hint.source: Click to change whom it follows (when that player is away it follows the owner, or else the nearest registered player).
gui.singulo.android_station.leader.hint.translation: 點擊切換跟隨的人（那個人不在時跟隨主人，主人也不在時跟隨附近已登記的人）。

gui.singulo.android_station.locked.source: You are not on this station's permit
gui.singulo.android_station.locked.translation: 你未登記在此組裝站的許可證上

gui.singulo.android_station.mode.0.hint.source: Waits by the station and fights enemies that come close.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.0.hint.translation: 在組裝站旁等待，只迎擊靠近的敵人。

gui.singulo.android_station.mode.1.hint.source: Roams within 16 blocks of the station and fights the enemies it finds.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.1.hint.translation: 在組裝站周圍（16 格）四處走動，擊敗發現的敵人。

gui.singulo.android_station.mode.2.hint.source: Follows its owner (the buttons below choose whether it fights nearby enemies). Recharges while walking with you if you carry a wireless charger.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.2.hint.translation: 跟隨主人（用下方按鈕選擇是否與附近的敵人戰鬥）。如果你帶著無線充電器，它會邊跟著走邊充電。

gui.singulo.android_station.mode.3.hint.source: Walks the route below (Work Location Cards) in order and fights enemies nearby. Calls idle allies when a fight starts, and when it spots a group of enemies or a boss, the station gives a redstone signal and the owner is told.
gui.singulo.android_station.mode.3.hint.translation: 按順序巡視下方巡邏路線（作業位置卡）的地點，與附近的敵人戰鬥。開始戰鬥時會呼叫空閒的同伴，發現敵人群體或首領時，組裝站會發出紅石訊號並通知主人。

gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.dwell.source: How long to stop and look around at each point. Click to change
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.dwell.translation: 在每個地點停下環顧的時間（點擊切換）

gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.night.source: Patrol only at night (waiting by the station in the day) or all the time. Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.night.translation: 只在夜間巡邏（白天在組裝站旁等待），還是一直巡邏（點擊切換）

gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.order.source: After the last point, go back to the first one (Loop) or come back the same way (Back & forth). Click to switch
gui.singulo.android_station.patrol.order.translation: 到達最後一個地點後，是回到第一個地點（循環），還是沿原路返回（往返）（點擊切換）

gui.singulo.android_station.permit.hint.source: With a shield permit inside, only the owner and registered players can open the station and android screens, and the android treats anyone else as an enemy and attacks them. You can also choose which registered player it follows.
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.hint.translation: 放入護盾通行證後，只有主人和已登記的人能打開組裝站和仿生人的介面，仿生人會把其他人視為敵人並發動攻擊。也可以從已登記的人中選擇跟隨誰。

gui.singulo.android_station.permit.membe.source: Only the owner and %s registered can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.membe.translation: 只有主人和已登記的 %s 人能操作

gui.singulo.android_station.permit.none.source: No permit: anyone can use it
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.none.translation: 無許可證：任何人都能操作

gui.singulo.android_station.permit.other.source: Anyone else is treated as an enemy and attacked
gui.singulo.android_station.permit.other.translation: 其他人會被視為敵人並遭到攻擊

gui.singulo.android_station.recall.hint.source: Click: recall the android shown. Shift-click: recall every android from the stations you can use within %s blocks.
gui.singulo.android_station.recall.hint.translation: 點擊：召回正在查看的仿生人。Shift+點擊：召回附近（%s 格以內）你能操作的組裝站的所有仿生人。

gui.singulo.android_station.retreat.hint.source: Below this share of health it returns to the station to repair and recharge.
gui.singulo.android_station.retreat.hint.translation: 生命值低於此比例時，返回組裝站維修並充電。

gui.singulo.android_station.route.hint.source: Patrol route: place Work Location Cards and the androids visit those places from left to right (up to 8), standing on top of each one to look around.
gui.singulo.android_station.route.hint.translation: 巡邏路線：放入作業位置卡後，會從左到右依次巡視這些地點（最多 8 個），站在卡片記錄的地點上方環顧四周。

gui.singulo.android_station.rules.hint.source: Switch to the page of route rules for patrols (required waypoints and no-entry zones)
gui.singulo.android_station.rules.hint.translation: 切換到巡邏移動規則（必經點・禁入區域）的頁面

gui.singulo.android_station.status.0.translation: 請放入小型水晶記憶體

gui.singulo.android_station.status.11.source: An android without a station is nearby
gui.singulo.android_station.status.11.translation: 附近有失去組裝站的仿生人

gui.singulo.android_station.status.2.source: Not enough power (40000 FE to print)
gui.singulo.android_station.status.2.translation: 電力不足（列印需要 40000 FE）

gui.singulo.archivist.death_1.source: ...I have been dreaming a long dream.

gui.singulo.archivist.death_2.source: A record is only a record when someone reads it.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_2.translation: 記錄，只有在有人閱讀時才成為記錄。

gui.singulo.archivist.death_3.source: Thank you. Never let go of the hand that stops the feed.
gui.singulo.archivist.death_3.translation: 謝謝你。請不要放開那隻停止投料的手。

gui.singulo.archivist.emerge_2.source: Then let me show you the last page.
gui.singulo.archivist.emerge_2.translation: 那麼，就讓你讀到最後一頁吧。

gui.singulo.archivist.halo.source: The halo unravels into spreading rings... Jump the low ones, crouch under the high ones!
gui.singulo.archivist.halo.translation: 光環解開，化作圓環向外擴散……低的環跳過去，高的環蹲下穿過！

gui.singulo.archivist.phase_2.source: Do you remember? Every record is here.
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_2.translation: 你還記得嗎。所有的記錄，都在這裡。

gui.singulo.archivist.phase_3.source: Light and records alike sink into this dark in the end.
gui.singulo.archivist.phase_3.translation: 光也好，記錄也好，終會沉入這片黑暗。

gui.singulo.archivist.reset.source: No challenger remains. The Archivist returns to the time field, leaving the Terminus Record on the console
gui.singulo.archivist.reset.translation: 挑戰者已離開，記錄者回到了時間場中。終焉之記錄留在了控制台上

gui.singulo.archivist.shield_down.source: The field sealing the chamber unravels.
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_down.translation: 封閉房間的力場消散了。

gui.singulo.archivist.shield_up.source: A field seals the chamber. No one leaves until it ends.
gui.singulo.archivist.shield_up.translation: 力場封閉了房間。在結束之前，誰也出不去。

gui.singulo.archivist.tide.source: Let me read you the record of weight.
gui.singulo.archivist.tide.translation: 讓我為你讀出重量的記錄。

gui.singulo.archivist.tide_final.source: There is nowhere left to fall.

gui.singulo.archivist.wings.source: The Last Archivist spreads its six wings...
gui.singulo.archivist.wings.translation: 最後的記錄者展開了六片羽翼……

gui.singulo.archivist.wings_hint.source: Stand in the shadow of a wing!

gui.singulo.cache.sealed.source: Sealed by a force field. Defeat this ruin's guardian
gui.singulo.cache.sealed.translation: 被力場封印。擊敗守護這座廢墟的守衛

gui.singulo.catalyst.underpowered.translation: 動力不足：催化劑磨損更快

gui.singulo.console.awakened.source: The seal breaks. The Horizon Warden awakens
gui.singulo.console.awakened.translation: 封印已破。視界守衛甦醒了

gui.singulo.console.awakened_defeated.source: The awakened warden is defeated. Fine parts spill from the wreck
gui.singulo.console.awakened_defeated.translation: 覺醒的守衛被擊退了。殘骸中滾出了優質零件

gui.singulo.console.awakened_rematch.source: The record core resonates. The Awakened Horizon Warden rises
gui.singulo.console.awakened_rematch.translation: 記錄核發生共鳴。覺醒的視界守衛甦醒了

gui.singulo.console.defeated.source: The warden falls silent. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.console.defeated.translation: 守衛沉寂了。保管庫的力場消散了

gui.singulo.console.no_vault.translation: 附近沒有被封鎖的保管庫

gui.singulo.console.open.source: The vault is not sealed (use an Awakening Record Core to fight the awakened warden)
gui.singulo.console.open.translation: 保管庫的封鎖已解除（使用覺醒記錄核，可與覺醒的守衛再戰）

gui.singulo.console.reset.source: No challenger remains. The warden returns to its seal
gui.singulo.console.reset.translation: 挑戰者已離開，守衛回到了封印之中

gui.singulo.device.generator.idle.translation: 持續供電 10 秒即可生成入口

gui.singulo.device.mouth.dormant.source: Closed. Add exotic matter to reopen
gui.singulo.device.mouth.dormant.translation: 已關閉。加入奇異物質即可重新開啟

gui.singulo.device.mouth.grace.translation: 首次放置的寬限：剩餘 %s 秒

gui.singulo.device.mouth.starving.translation: 燃料耗盡：%s 秒後收縮

gui.singulo.device.port.channel_hint.source: Toggle the seven circles to set the number (0-127). Links to the active port with the same number on the far side
gui.singulo.device.port.channel_hint.translation: 點擊 7 個圓圈切換開關來設定編號（0-127）。會與另一端編號相同、正在運作的埠相連

gui.singulo.device.port.hint.translation: 相鄰的裝置會與另一端相連

gui.singulo.device.port.inactive.source: Inactive: the mouth has too many ports
gui.singulo.device.port.inactive.translation: 已停止：入口的埠數量超過上限

gui.singulo.device.port.rank.translation: 距入口第 %s 個 / 上限 %s 個

gui.singulo.device.standby.hint.source: Fuel and catalyst are not used. Resumes when storage falls under 75%.
gui.singulo.device.standby.hint.translation: 不消耗燃料和催化劑。儲能低於 75% 時恢復

gui.singulo.generator_slots.fusion.in.source: Insert muon catalysts. At default settings, a fresh one lasts 10 minutes; a used one burns for half its remaining lifetime. Spent catalysts come out below.
gui.singulo.generator_slots.fusion.in.translation: 放入緲子催化劑。預設設定下，新的可運轉 10 分鐘，用過的僅運轉其剩餘壽命的一半。失活的催化劑從下方輸出。

gui.singulo.generator_slots.no_heat.source: No heat source (put lava or a magma block next to it)
gui.singulo.generator_slots.no_heat.translation: 沒有高溫源（在旁邊放熔岩或岩漿塊等）

gui.singulo.generator_slots.turbine.in.source: Insert coolant cartridges: the liquid nitrogen goes into the tank and the empty cartridges come out below
gui.singulo.generator_slots.turbine.in.translation: 放入冷媒罐後，會把液態氮倒進儲槽，並在下方送出空罐

gui.singulo.genesis.bar.surge.translation: ⚠ 失控中　快停止投料！　不穩定度 %s

gui.singulo.genesis.bar.surge_held.translation: 正在壓制失控　不穩定度 %s

gui.singulo.genesis.birth_1.source: The light falls into a single point...

gui.singulo.genesis.birth_2.source: All mass became energy. So now,
gui.singulo.genesis.birth_2.translation: 所有的質量都化為了能量。所以這一次，

gui.singulo.genesis.birth_3.translation: 要從能量之中，孕育一個宇宙。

gui.singulo.genesis.birth_sky.source: The newborn galaxy rises into the night sky
gui.singulo.genesis.birth_sky.translation: 誕生的銀河，升上了夜空

gui.singulo.genesis.collapse.source: The proto-universe nearly collapses. Progress is lost
gui.singulo.genesis.collapse.translation: 即將誕生的宇宙幾乎崩塌。進度倒退了

gui.singulo.genesis.complete.source: The Genesis Engine can now make mass. Choose an item on the core's screen
gui.singulo.genesis.complete.translation: 創世爐現在能夠創造質量了。在核心介面中選擇要製造的物品吧

gui.singulo.genesis.event.echoes.source: Echoes of the records are drawn in
gui.singulo.genesis.event.echoes.translation: 記錄的殘響被吸引而來

gui.singulo.genesis.event.wave.source: A wave of gravity rises. Brace for the fall
gui.singulo.genesis.event.wave.translation: 引力之波來襲。準備好落地

gui.singulo.genesis.formed.source: The Genesis Engine takes shape. Use a Primordial Seed on the core to begin
gui.singulo.genesis.formed.translation: 創世爐成形了。對核心使用原初之種，宇宙便開始誕生

gui.singulo.genesis.hint.0.source: Surround the core with 8 frames and 12 pylons
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.0.translation: 用 8 個框架和 12 根支柱圍住核心

gui.singulo.genesis.hint.1.source: Use a Primordial Seed on the core
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.1.translation: 手持原初之種對核心使用

gui.singulo.genesis.hint.2.source: Pour in power to grow the kindling

gui.singulo.genesis.hint.3.source: Keep power up; stop the feed on a surge
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.3.translation: 維持供電；出現失控徵兆時停止投料

gui.singulo.genesis.hint.5.source: Put an item in the frame to make it
gui.singulo.genesis.hint.5.translation: 把想製造的物品放入左側框中，即可用電力製造

gui.singulo.genesis.kindled.source: The seed ignites and a universe begins to swell. Keep the upkeep flowing and watch for surges
gui.singulo.genesis.kindled.translation: 火種點燃，宇宙開始膨脹。保持維持電力不斷，留意失控的徵兆

gui.singulo.genesis.not_synthesizable.source: The Genesis Engine cannot make that

gui.singulo.genesis.screen.feed_tip.source: Click to stop or resume the feed

gui.singulo.genesis.screen.feed_tip_stab.source: While stopped, upkeep still drains the buffer and events still happen. Feeding without enough power raises instability
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.feed_tip_stab.translation: 停止期間仍會從儲能中消耗維持電力，事件也照樣發生。電力不足時繼續投料，不穩定度會上升

gui.singulo.genesis.screen.template_tip_.source: Click with an item to choose it (it is not used up)
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.template_tip_.translation: 手持物品點擊即可登記（物品不會消耗）

gui.singulo.genesis.screen.template_tip_.source: Click empty-handed to clear; shift-click items to choose
gui.singulo.genesis.screen.template_tip_.translation: 空手點擊可解除；也可Shift點擊物品登記

gui.singulo.genesis.seeded.source: The seed sinks in. Pour in power to kindle it
gui.singulo.genesis.seeded.translation: 原初之種沉入其中。注入電力以點燃種火

gui.singulo.genesis.surge.source: Surge warning! Stop the feed (the switch on the core screen, or a redstone signal)
gui.singulo.genesis.surge.translation: 失控徵兆！停止投料（核心介面的開關，或紅石訊號）

gui.singulo.genesis.surge_end.source: The surge subsides. You may resume the feed
gui.singulo.genesis.surge_end.translation: 宇宙的翻湧平息了。可以恢復投料

gui.singulo.genesis.unformed.source: Not formed (surround the core with 8 frames and 12 pylons)
gui.singulo.genesis.unformed.translation: 未成形（用 8 個框架與 12 根支柱圍住核心）

gui.singulo.glasses.hint.source: Moves one pixel at a time. The height stays with the glasses and others see it too.
gui.singulo.glasses.hint.translation: 每次上下移動1像素。高度保存在眼鏡上，其他人看到的也一樣

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.echo_senti.source: The echoes of the archive take shape. The Echo Sentinel appears
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.echo_senti.translation: 檔案室的回聲凝聚成形。回聲守衛現身了

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.ergosphere.source: A vortex opens in the dead core. Something small crawls out...
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.ergosphere.translation: 停止的爐心中張開了漩渦。有什麼小東西爬了出來……

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.foundry_ov.source: The production lines start up. The Foundry Overseer wakes
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.foundry_ov.translation: 生產線啟動了。製造統籌 AI「鑄造廠」醒來了

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.gravity_re.source: The containment tank shatters. The Gravity Remnant crawls out
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened.gravity_re.translation: 收容槽碎裂了。重力殘渣爬了出來

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_defeated.source: The awakened guardian is defeated. Fine fragments spill out
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_defeated.translation: 擊退了覺醒的守衛。上等的碎片散落出來

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.ec.source: The core resonates. The Awakened Echo Sentinel appears
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.ec.translation: 覺醒核發生共鳴。覺醒的回聲守衛現身了

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.er.source: The core resonates. The Awakened Ergosphere Leviathan tears through the vortex
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.er.translation: 覺醒核發生共鳴。覺醒的能層巨蛇撕裂漩渦現身了

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.fo.source: The awakening core resonates. The Awakened Foundry restarts every line
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.fo.translation: 覺醒核發生共鳴。覺醒的鑄造廠重新啟動了所有生產線

gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.gr.source: The core resonates. The Awakened Gravity Remnant crawls out
gui.singulo.guardian.awakened_rematch.gr.translation: 覺醒核發生共鳴。覺醒的重力殘渣爬了出來

gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.echo_senti.source: The Echo Sentinel unravels. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.echo_senti.translation: 回聲守衛消散了。保管庫的力場消失了

gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.ergosphere.source: The Ergosphere Leviathan sinks into the vortex. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.ergosphere.translation: 能層巨蛇沉入了漩渦之底。保管庫的力場消失了

gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.foundry_ov.source: The Foundry's eye goes dark. The lines halt and the vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.foundry_ov.translation: 鑄造廠的獨眼熄滅了。生產線停止，保管庫的力場消失了

gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.gravity_re.source: The Gravity Remnant collapses. The vault field dissipates
gui.singulo.guardian.defeated.gravity_re.translation: 重力殘渣的核心坍縮了。保管庫的力場消失了

gui.singulo.guardian.no_vault.translation: 附近沒有受守衛保護的保管庫

gui.singulo.guardian.reset.echo_sentinel.source: No challenger remains. The Echo Sentinel returns to the records
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.echo_sentinel.translation: 挑戰者已離開，回聲守衛回到了記錄之中

gui.singulo.guardian.reset.ergosphere_le.source: No challenger remains. The Ergosphere Leviathan returns to the core
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.ergosphere_le.translation: 挑戰者已離開，能層巨蛇回到了爐心的漩渦中

gui.singulo.guardian.reset.foundry_overs.source: No challenger remains. The Foundry halts its lines and powers down
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.foundry_overs.translation: 挑戰者已離開，鑄造廠停下生產線，進入了休眠

gui.singulo.guardian.reset.gravity_remna.source: No challenger remains. The Gravity Remnant sinks back into its tank
gui.singulo.guardian.reset.gravity_remna.translation: 挑戰者已離開，重力殘渣沉回了槽中

gui.singulo.guardian.wrong_core.source: This is not the awakening core for this ruin's guardian
gui.singulo.guardian.wrong_core.translation: 這不是這座廢墟守衛的覺醒核

gui.singulo.halo.no_core.translation: %s 格內沒有正在運作的爐心

gui.singulo.halo.status.translation: 收集 %s mB/秒 · 內部 %s mB

gui.singulo.handbook.no_records.source: No records decoded yet. Find crystal memories in ruins and decode them in the Archive Terminal.
gui.singulo.handbook.no_records.translation: 還沒有解讀過任何記錄。在廢墟中尋找水晶記憶體，並在檔案終端解讀吧。

gui.singulo.handbook.read_flow.source: → Read the stage %s overview (what to do, in order)
gui.singulo.handbook.read_flow.translation: → 閱讀第 %s 階段的流程（要做的事的順序）

gui.singulo.handbook.support_hint.source: Support the author on Ko-fi (opens in your browser)
gui.singulo.handbook.support_hint.translation: 在 Ko-fi 上支持作者（在瀏覽器中開啟）

gui.singulo.leviathan.ascend.source: The vortex tears open and a black wyrm rises, its wings a spread of accretion-disk light
gui.singulo.leviathan.ascend.translation: 漩渦被撕開，一條黑龍升了上來。像翅膀一樣展開的，是吸積盤的光

gui.singulo.leviathan.molt.source: The Leviathan shudders. Its reactor-plate scales burst away, baring a skeleton of light
gui.singulo.leviathan.molt.translation: 巨蛇渾身顫抖。反應爐外殼的鱗片四散彈飛，露出了光之骨骼

gui.singulo.leviathan.quake.source: The Leviathan rises and curls up... Jump over the shockwaves!
gui.singulo.leviathan.quake.translation: 巨蛇高高升起，蜷起身體……衝擊波到來時跳起來！

gui.singulo.leviathan.reignite.translation: 停止的爐心之渦正在甦醒……

gui.singulo.leviathan.rift.source: Lines of light cross the floor... Get off them!
gui.singulo.leviathan.rift.translation: 光線劃過地面……快離開線上！

gui.singulo.leviathan.submerge.source: The Leviathan dives into the core vortex. The vortex widens and swallows the light...
gui.singulo.leviathan.submerge.translation: 巨蛇潛入了爐心的漩渦。漩渦擴張，光被吸了進去……

gui.singulo.leviathan.swallow.source: --The floor splits and colossal jaws swallow it whole. The Ergosphere Leviathan rises
gui.singulo.leviathan.swallow.translation: ——地板裂開，巨大的顎將牠一口吞下。能層巨蛇現身了

gui.singulo.leviathan.tide.source: The core vortex opens and drags everything in... Run against the pull!
gui.singulo.leviathan.tide.translation: 爐心之渦張開，吞噬一切……逆著引力向外跑！

gui.singulo.make_free.off.translation: 不製作無需材料的配方

gui.singulo.make_free.on.translation: 也製作無需材料的配方

gui.singulo.observatory.on.translation: 顯示：開 · 礦石 %s · 廢墟 %s

gui.singulo.reactor.burst.source: The core evaporated. Restart it with a Singularity Core and ignition power
gui.singulo.reactor.burst.translation: 爐心已完全蒸發。可用奇點核心與點火電力重新啟動

gui.singulo.reactor.collapse.source: The reactor is collapsing under the mass!
gui.singulo.reactor.collapse.translation: 反應爐承受不住質量，正在崩潰！

gui.singulo.reactor.harvest.hint.source: Keeps core mass at 480 or less so H condensate (needs a Hawking Collector) keeps forming every 5 minutes. Power output is small. An overgrown core sheds 2 mass per second through its jets until it is back. New reactors start in this mode
gui.singulo.reactor.harvest.hint.translation: 將爐心質量保持在 480 以下，使霍金凝聚體（需要霍金收集器）每 5 分鐘產生一個。發電量較小。質量超過 480 的爐心會透過噴流每秒釋放 2 質量直至恢復。新反應爐以此模式啟動

gui.singulo.reactor.ignition.need.translation: 點火：%s 秒內 %s GFE（平均 %s MFE/t）

gui.singulo.reactor.ignition_failed.source: Ignition failed: not enough power in time
gui.singulo.reactor.ignition_failed.translation: 點火失敗：電力未能及時送達

gui.singulo.reactor.ignition_failed.deta.source: Delivered %s / %s GFE, peak intake %s MFE/t (need %s MFE/t). Even with enough storage, the lowest-capacity cable on the power route caps the intake
gui.singulo.reactor.ignition_failed.deta.translation: 送達 %s / %s GFE，最大受電 %s MFE/t（需要 %s MFE/t）。即使儲能足夠，送電路徑中容量最低的線纜也會限制受電上限

gui.singulo.reactor.mode.shedding.translation: 正在釋放質量（回收運轉）

gui.singulo.reactor.recaptured.source: The rogue black hole is now the core
gui.singulo.reactor.recaptured.translation: 已將流浪黑洞納入爐心

gui.singulo.reactor.state.igniting.translation: 點火中 %s%% · 剩餘 %s 秒

gui.singulo.reason.ambiguous.source: The materials for %s are in, but the same mix appears while loading other recipes, so it is not made automatically.
gui.singulo.reason.ambiguous.translation: %s 的材料已齊，但與放入其他配方材料途中的組合相同，因此不會自動製作

gui.singulo.reason.arrange.source: - The amounts are there. Try putting each material in its own slot.
gui.singulo.reason.arrange.translation: ・數量已經足夠。請試著把每種材料分別放進不同的槽位。

gui.singulo.reason.empty.translation: 放入材料即可開始運作

gui.singulo.reason.extra.source: The materials for %s are in, but so are items it does not use, so it is not made automatically.
gui.singulo.reason.extra.translation: %s 的材料已齊，但還放有用不到的物品，因此不會自動製作

gui.singulo.reason.need_fluid.source: - %s: %s mB more needed (%s mB per craft)

gui.singulo.reason.no_match.source: Nothing this machine makes uses these materials. Check the handbook or JEI for the right inputs.
gui.singulo.reason.no_match.translation: 這台裝置無法用放入的材料製作任何東西。請在手冊或 JEI 中確認所需的材料。

gui.singulo.reason.no_power.source: Needs %s FE per tick but only %s FE is stored. Add generators or turn off other machines.
gui.singulo.reason.no_power.translation: 每 tick 需要 %s FE，但只儲存了 %s FE。請增加發電，或關閉其他裝置。

gui.singulo.reason.not_formed.source: The structure is not complete. Use a Holo Projector on the controller to see missing blocks.
gui.singulo.reason.not_formed.translation: 結構尚未完成。對控制器使用全像投影器，即可查看缺少的方塊。

gui.singulo.reason.off.source: Turned off with the power switch

gui.singulo.reason.output_full.source: The output slot or tank is full. Take things out, or turn on auto-eject in the side settings.
gui.singulo.reason.output_full.translation: 輸出槽或輸出儲槽已滿。請取出物品，或在面設定中開啟自動輸出。

gui.singulo.reason.select_hint.source: Pick what to make with the button below the output.
gui.singulo.reason.select_hint.translation: 請用輸出欄下方的按鈕指定要製作的物品

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.clear_card.hi.source: Erase the recipe on the recorded card
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.clear_card.hi.translation: 清除已記錄卡上的配方

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.encode.hint.source: Record this recipe onto the card in the recorded slot (takes one from the stock if it is empty)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.encode.hint.translation: 把這個排列記錄到「已記錄」欄的卡上（為空時從庫存取一張）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.extra.hint.source: Anything else that comes out (byproducts). It is taken out and returned to the stockpile
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.extra.hint.translation: 其他產出的物品（副產物）。取出後放回資材存放處

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.f.source: Which face of the machine fuel goes in through. Auto: the side the android stands at (a furnace's fuel slot)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.f.translation: 從裝置的哪個面放入燃料。自動：仿生人所站的側面（熔爐為燃料欄）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.i.source: Which face of the machine materials go in through (click to change, right-click to go back). Auto: tries top, sides, then bottom, and uses the first face that takes the material (usually all you need). Directions are world directions
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.i.translation: 從裝置的哪個面放入材料（點擊切換，右鍵反向）。自動：依上、側面、下的順序，從接受該材料的面放入（通常這樣就行）。東南西北為世界方向

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.o.source: Which face of the machine products are taken out from (click to change, right-click to go back). Auto: tries bottom, sides, then top, and uses the first face the products come out of (furnaces use the bottom)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.face_button.o.translation: 從裝置的哪個面取出產物（點擊切換，右鍵反向）。自動：依下、側面、上的順序，從能取出產物的面取出（熔爐類為下）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.fuel.hint.source: The fuel to fetch when the machine runs out, and how many to bring each time (scroll to change). Leave it empty to never fetch fuel
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.fuel.hint.translation: 裝置燃料耗盡時要去取的燃料，以及每次帶來的數量（滾動滾輪變更數量）。留空則不去取

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.fuel_mode.hin.source: How much fuel is brought each time (click to switch). ×N: the count in the fuel slot (never more than the machine can take). Fill: as much as the machine can take
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.fuel_mode.hin.translation: 每次帶來的燃料數量（點擊切換）。N 個：按燃料欄的數量（裝置放不下的部分不帶）。加滿：裝置能放入多少就帶多少

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.grid.hint.source: Click with an item to place a copy as a pattern (it is not used up)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.grid.hint.translation: 拿著物品點擊即可放置樣本（物品不會減少）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.kind.hint.source: Switch the kind of step to add (right-click to go back). Insert/Extract: into or out of a machine. Mine/Fell: dig an area or cut trees (needs an upgrade). Harvest: pick crops and replant. Breed/Shear/Milk/Cull: tend the animals in an area. Use: flip levers, press buttons and the like
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.kind.hint.translation: 切換要新增的步驟種類（右鍵反向）。放入/取出：放入或取出裝置。採掘/伐木：挖掘範圍或砍樹（需要升級）。收穫：收取作物並補種。繁殖/剪毛/擠奶/處理：照料範圍內的動物。操作：使用拉桿、按鈕等

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.limit.hint.source: Number of animals. Breed: increase each kind up to this many. Cull: cull any above this many. Click or scroll to change (Shift: 10 at a time, right-click to lower)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.limit.hint.translation: 動物的數量。繁殖：同種增加到此數量。處理：處理超過此數量的部分。點擊或滾動滾輪變更（Shift：每次10，右鍵減少）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.mode.hint.source: Switch what is recorded. Crafting: made at a crafting table. Processing: put into a furnace or machine from above and taken out from below. Procedure: insert, extract and mine steps on a Procedure Card
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.mode.hint.translation: 切換要記錄的種類。工作台：在工作台製作。加工：從上方放入熔爐或裝置，從下方取出。步驟：在步驟卡上記錄放入、取出、採掘的步驟

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.output.hint.source: Place what comes out (the main product)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.output.hint.translation: 放置產出的物品（主產物）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.product.hint.source: What these steps produce, per run. It can be ordered as this item at the console
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.product.hint.translation: 這些步驟的產物（每次的數量）。在指令台上可作為該物品下單

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.add.hint.source: Add a step at the place on the Work Location Card, with the item in the item slot (up to eight)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.add.hint.translation: 用作業位置卡的位置和物品欄中的物品新增一個步驟（最多8個）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.item.hin.source: What to insert, extract or gather (scroll to change the count). For breeding, the feed; for milking, how many buckets of milk (empty buckets are taken along). Leave it empty for mining and the like to gather the product
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.item.hin.translation: 要放入、取出或收集的物品（滾動滾輪變更數量）。繁殖時為飼料，擠奶時為要取的牛奶數量（會帶上空桶）。採掘等留空則收集產物

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.loc_a.hi.source: A Work Location Card holding the place for the step
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.loc_a.hi.translation: 記錄了步驟位置的作業位置卡

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.loc_b.hi.source: The other corner of the mining area (optional; with it, the box between the two cards is mined)
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.loc_b.hi.translation: 採掘範圍的另一角（可省略。放置後挖掘兩張卡之間的範圍）

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.no_item.source: Place the item to insert or extract in the item slot
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.no_item.translation: 請在物品欄中放入要放入或取出的物品

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.no_place.source: Place a Work Location Card holding a place in this dimension
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.no_place.translation: 請放入記錄了本維度位置的作業位置卡

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.too_big.source: The mining area can be at most %s blocks on a side
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.step.too_big.translation: 採掘範圍每邊最多 %s 格

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.stock.hint.source: Keep a stack of blank recipe cards here. When the recorded-card slot is empty, Save takes one from here
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.stock.hint.translation: 在這裡放一組未記錄的配方卡，「已記錄」欄為空時，記錄會從這裡取一張

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.use.hint.source: What to do with a lever (click to change). Buttons, doors, trapdoors and the like are always used like a right-click
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.use.hint.translation: 如何操作拉桿（點擊變更）。按鈕、門、活板門等總是與右鍵相同

gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.variants.hint.source: Any variant: use anything the recipe accepts in that slot, not just the pattern item (any wood planks, for example). Same item only: use exactly the pattern items
gui.singulo.recipe_encoder.variants.hint.translation: 同類也可：即使不是樣本中的物品，也會使用配方認可的同類物品（各種木板等）。僅相同物品：只使用與樣本相同的物品

gui.singulo.route.hint.0.source: Moving into or out of the area, androids pass the waypoint
gui.singulo.route.hint.0.translation: 進出對象範圍時，會經過途經點，

gui.singulo.route.hint.1.source: and stay out of its no-entry zones on the way (up to 4 rows)
gui.singulo.route.hint.1.translation: 途中避開禁入區域（最多 4 行）

gui.singulo.route.scope.hint.source: Area (Area Card): only moves into or out of this area go through the waypoint
gui.singulo.route.scope.hint.translation: 對象範圍（範圍卡）：只有進出這個範圍的移動才會經過途經點

gui.singulo.route.via.hint.source: Waypoint (Work Location Card): androids moving into or out of the area pass over this place
gui.singulo.route.via.hint.translation: 途經點（作業位置卡）：進出對象範圍時，會從這個地點上方經過

gui.singulo.route.zone.hint.source: No-entry zone (Area Card, up to 2): androids stay out of it while moving through the waypoint (unless they start or end inside it)
gui.singulo.route.zone.hint.translation: 禁入區域（範圍卡，最多 2 個）：經過途經點的移動期間不進入這裡（包含出發地或目的地的區域除外）

gui.singulo.select.auto_hint.source: Makes only a recipe that uses everything inside, and never one whose mix also appears partway through another recipe.
gui.singulo.select.auto_hint.translation: 只製作會用到全部已放入物品的配方，不製作與其他配方中途相同的材料組合

gui.singulo.select.button_hint.source: Click to choose; right-click for automatic.
gui.singulo.select.button_hint.translation: 點擊選擇，右鍵恢復自動

gui.singulo.select.fixed_hint.source: Makes only this recipe; anything else inside is left alone.
gui.singulo.select.fixed_hint.translation: 只製作這個配方，放入的其他物品不會被使用

gui.singulo.shield.full.source: Guards: explosions, griefing, hostile spawns, intrusion
gui.singulo.shield.full.translation: 防護：爆炸、破壞、敵對生物生成、入侵

gui.singulo.shield.permit_on.source: Permit: only %s players may build inside
gui.singulo.shield.permit_on.translation: 許可證：只有 %s 名玩家可在內部建造

gui.singulo.sides.hint.source: Drag to rotate · click to change · right-click for auto-eject
gui.singulo.sides.hint.translation: 拖曳旋轉 · 點擊切換 · 右鍵切換自動排出

gui.singulo.sides.legend.source: Grey off · Blue in · Orange out · Green both
gui.singulo.sides.legend.translation: 灰：停用 · 藍：輸入 · 橙：輸出 · 綠：輸入輸出

gui.singulo.sides.legend_tank_in.source: Coloured faces accept input · Grey off
gui.singulo.sides.legend_tank_in.translation: 有顏色的面可輸入 · 灰：停用

gui.singulo.sides.legend_tank_out.translation: 有顏色的面可輸出 · 灰：停用

gui.singulo.smes.hint.source: Up to %s FE/t. Receives on the other five faces
gui.singulo.smes.hint.translation: 最大 %s FE/t。從正面以外的五個面接收

gui.singulo.supporters.empty.source: Supporter names will be added in future updates.
gui.singulo.supporters.empty.translation: 支持者的名字將在今後的更新中加入。

gui.singulo.supporters.intro.source: Thank you to everyone supporting the development of Singulo. The names listed here also appear in the ending.
gui.singulo.supporters.intro.translation: 感謝所有支持 Singulo 開發的朋友。這裡列出的名字也會出現在結局中。

gui.singulo.thermo.melting.translation: 低溫源正在融化：可維持溫差 %s K

gui.singulo.thermo.none.source: No heat source or heat sink adjacent
gui.singulo.thermo.none.translation: 相鄰沒有熱源或低溫源

gui.singulo.work_console.again.source: Order the same item again (you can change the amount before ordering)
gui.singulo.work_console.again.translation: 再次訂購同一物品（可在確認畫面更改數量）

gui.singulo.work_console.auto_android.source: None chosen: only as many of the %s available androids as the work needs will start
gui.singulo.work_console.auto_android.translation: 未選擇，將從可選的 %s 個仿生人中只派出工作所需的數量

gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.recip.source: Cancelled the order for %s (the recipe does not match)
gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.recip.translation: 已取消 %s 的訂單（配方不符）

gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.stall.source: Cancelled the order for %s (the machine stopped processing)
gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.stall.translation: 已取消 %s 的訂單（裝置的加工沒有進展）

gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.unrea.source: Cancelled the order for %s (a place could not be reached)
gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.unrea.translation: 已取消 %s 的訂單（有無法到達的地方）

gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.wrong.source: Cancelled the order for %s (the machine does not take materials through its %s face)
gui.singulo.work_console.cancelled.wrong.translation: 已取消 %s 的訂單（裝置不接受從放入面（%s）放入的材料）

gui.singulo.work_console.choose_android.source: No android can take this order

gui.singulo.work_console.crafted.hint.source: Crafted by the androids. Leftovers go back to the stockpile
gui.singulo.work_console.crafted.hint.translation: 由仿生人製作的物品。剩餘的會放回資材存放處

gui.singulo.work_console.delivery.hint.source: Click to change where it is delivered (right-click to go back). Name delivery ports in their own screen
gui.singulo.work_console.delivery.hint.translation: 點擊切換交付目標（右鍵反向）。交付口的名字可在交付口的介面中設定

gui.singulo.work_console.detail.hint.source: Click to see the steps and what each android is doing
gui.singulo.work_console.detail.hint.translation: 點擊查看工序和仿生人的狀態

gui.singulo.work_console.detail.machine_.translation: （%s 在裝置中加工，約剩 %s 秒）

gui.singulo.work_console.empty.source: Nothing to order (link supply ports and recipe racks)
gui.singulo.work_console.empty.translation: 沒有可訂購的物品（連接資材口和配方架）

gui.singulo.work_console.error.capacity.source: No chosen android can carry the materials for %s at once (a backpack is needed, or a Tank Upgrade for fluids)
gui.singulo.work_console.error.capacity.translation: 沒有能一次搬運 %s 所需材料的仿生人（需要背包，流體則需要儲罐升級）

gui.singulo.work_console.error.no_androi.translation: 沒有選擇空閒的仿生人

gui.singulo.work_console.error.no_feller.source: %s needs felling, but no chosen android has a Felling Upgrade
gui.singulo.work_console.error.no_feller.translation: %s 的步驟包含伐木，但所選仿生人都沒有伐木升級

gui.singulo.work_console.error.no_miner.source: %s needs mining, but no chosen android has a Mining Upgrade
gui.singulo.work_console.error.no_miner.translation: %s 需要採掘，但所選仿生人都沒有採掘升級

gui.singulo.work_console.error.not_machi.source: Items cannot be put into or taken from the work location for %s
gui.singulo.work_console.error.not_machi.translation: 無法向 %s 的工作位置放入或取出物品

guide.singulo.androids.build.body.source:
Put a compact crystal memory (sets the design; never used up) and android kits (one per print) in an Android Assembly Station and supply power, and it prints one guard android on top (40,000 FE each). If it falls, the station prints it again while kits last. Whoever places the station owns it.
- Guards attack hostile mobs only (ruin androids and drones too) and never fight players or bosses. Player and boss attacks do not hurt them.
- Modes: Guard (waits by the station), Wander (roams within 16 blocks), Follow (goes with its owner), Patrol (walks a set route). While following, choose "Just follow" or "Escort" (fights nearby enemies).
- Permit: with a Shield Permit in the station, only the owner and registered players can open the station and android screens. The android treats anyone else (except in Creative) as an enemy and attacks them, and their attacks can hurt it. You can also choose whether it follows the owner or one of the registered players.
- Return health: below it, the android goes back to repair and recharge (hover to see its current health and charge). Recall sends it back at once; shift-click Recall to call back every android from the stations you can use within 64 blocks.
- Name: click the name in the station or android screen to rename it (the ↺ button restores the nickname).
- Comparator: the station outputs a signal (0-15) from the android's health.
- Break the station and the android stays where it is. Put a matching memory in a new station and press Link to bring it back.
- Daily life: with nothing to do, guards relax near the station. They sit on stairs, slabs or chairs (napping at night), hold a hand over potted plants and crops, sweep the floor, put items left lying around into a nearby chest, chat with each other, shelter from the rain (or stay out under an umbrella if they hold one), and watch the sunset or the night sky..
guide.singulo.androids.build.body.translation:
在仿生人組裝站放入小型水晶記憶體（決定型號，不會消耗）和仿生人套件（每次列印一個）並供電，它就會在上方列印一個護衛仿生人（每次 40,000 FE）。被擊倒後，只要還有套件就會重新列印。放置組裝站的人就是主人。
- 護衛只攻擊敵對生物（包括遺蹟的仿生人和無人機），從不與玩家或首領戰鬥。玩家和首領的攻擊不會傷到它。
- 行動方式：迎擊（在組裝站旁等待）、徘徊（在 16 格內四處走動）、跟隨（跟著主人）、巡邏（巡視設定的地點）。跟隨時可以選擇「只跟隨」或「護衛」（與附近的敵人戰鬥）。
- 許可證：在組裝站放入護盾通行證後，只有主人和已登記的人能打開組裝站和仿生人的介面。仿生人會把其他人（創造模式除外）視為敵人並發動攻擊，他們的攻擊也能傷到仿生人。也可以選擇跟隨主人還是某位已登記的人。
- 返回生命：低於此值時，仿生人會回去維修並充電。按「召回」可立即讓它回去。（把游標移到上面會顯示目前生命和充電）。Shift+點擊「召回」可召回附近（64 格以內）你能操作的組裝站的所有仿生人。
- 名字：在組裝站或仿生人介面中點擊名字即可改名（↺ 按鈕恢復暱稱）。
- 比較器：組裝站會根據仿生人的生命輸出訊號（0〜15）。
- 組裝站被破壞後，仿生人會留在原地。在新的組裝站放入相同型號的記憶體並按「連結」即可重新連接。
- 日常生活：無事可做時，護衛會在組裝站附近休息。坐在樓梯、半磚或椅子上（夜裡會打盹），把手放在盆栽和作物上方，掃地，把掉在地上一段時間的物品收進附近的箱子，和同伴聊天，下雨時躲到屋簷下（拿著傘就留在外面），眺望夕陽或夜空。

guide.singulo.androids.care.body.source:
- Charging: a guard refills in 5 s back at its station (using power, and it heals too). While following, if you carry an Android Wireless Charger it comes to you and refills in 5 s as it walks with you (a full charger holds 30 refills; right-click a block that supplies power to charge it). With the station far away and no charger, it uses solar power or sits down. When it has nothing to do and is within 24 blocks of its station, it goes back on its own to top up whenever its charge is not full.
- Inventory: right-click your android to open its screen. A stack of Self-Repair Kits: one is used to restore half its health when it drops below the return health. One Android Armor Plate works as its chestplate (+8 armor, +2 toughness) and takes armor enchantments; it shows as plating on the chest and left shoulder.
- Kits in the station's refill slot top up the android whenever it has used one. A Transfer Upgrade in the upgrade slot passes a fallen android's inventory to the next one (otherwise it drops). Hoppers and pipes can insert into the station; nothing can be pulled out.
- Dismantle: press the wrench in the android screen twice; it fades away from the top and the station prints a new one at once.
guide.singulo.androids.care.body.translation:
- 充電：護衛回到組裝站後 5 秒充滿（消耗電力，同時恢復生命）。跟隨時，如果你帶著仿生人無線充電器，它會來到你身邊，邊跟著走邊在 5 秒內充滿（充電器充滿時可用 30 次；右鍵點擊能輸出電力的方塊為其充電）。組裝站很遠又沒有充電器時，它會用太陽能或坐下充電。無事可做且在組裝站 24 格以內時，只要電量沒滿，就會自己回去充滿。
- 物品：右鍵點擊自己的仿生人即可打開其介面。一組自我修理套件：生命低於返回生命時用掉一個，恢復一半生命。一塊仿生人用裝甲板作為胸甲生效（護甲 +8，盔甲韌性 +2），可附上護甲類附魔，裝上後胸口和左肩會出現裝甲。
- 組裝站補充欄位中的修理套件，會在仿生人用掉一個時自動補充。強化欄位中的傳送升級會把倒下仿生人的物品交給下一個（沒有則掉落）。漏斗和管道可以向組裝站輸入，但無法取出。
- 拆解：在仿生人介面中按兩次扳手，它會從上方逐漸消失，組裝站隨即列印新的仿生人。

guide.singulo.androids.decor.body.source:
Switch pages with the button left of the name in the android screen; the third page is Decorations, with head, back/waist and hand slots. Decorations do not affect fighting or work. They are all made on a crafting table and can be dyed there with dyes, like leather armor.
- Head: ribbon, hair flower, beret, headdress or glasses
- Back/waist: cape, scarf or waist ribbon (the cape and the scarf's tail flutter as it walks)
- Hand: paperback, bouquet, teacup or umbrella (held only while idle; put away while fighting, working or charging)
guide.singulo.androids.decor.body.translation:
在仿生人介面中用名字左邊的按鈕切換頁面，第 3 頁是「裝飾」頁。可在頭部、背部/腰部、手部的欄位裝上裝飾。不影響戰鬥和作業。全部在工作台製作，可與染料一起在工作台染色（與皮革盔甲相同）。
・頭部：緞帶、髮飾、貝雷帽、頭飾、眼鏡
・背部/腰部：披風、圍巾、腰部緞帶（披風和圍巾的末端行走時會飄動）
・手部：文庫本、花束、茶杯、傘（僅在待機時拿著。戰鬥、作業、充電時會收起）

guide.singulo.androids.farm.body.source:
- Farming: Harvest (picks ripe crops and replants; sugar cane and cactus keep their base), Fell (cuts whole trees and replants saplings; needs a Felling Upgrade), Breed (feeds animals up to a set number), Shear and Milk (empty buckets are taken along) and Cull (anything above a set number). Named, leashed and tamed animals and babies are left alone.
- Use: flips levers (on, off or toggle), presses buttons, opens doors and so on, to drive contraptions.
- Liquids and gases: tanks next to supply ports or the console join the stockpile. Click a pattern slot in processing or procedure mode with a bucket or other fluid container, or use JEI's + button, to place a fluid (scroll for 100 mB steps, Shift for 1000 mB). Androids with a Tank Upgrade carry fluids to machines. Orders that make a fluid fill the stockpile tanks.
- Fuel: record a fuel in the fuel slot of the processing mode, and when the machine runs out, androids fetch that fuel from the stockpile and load it (the count you set each time, or as much as fits with the Fill button below the slot; never more than the machine can take. Leave it empty to never fetch fuel). If the stockpile has none and there is a recipe for it, an order to make the fuel is placed automatically (the androids do other work meanwhile).
- Chance outputs: if fewer come out than planned, materials for the rest are taken from the stockpile and the step repeats until enough is collected (if materials run short, it waits). Harvesting, felling and ranching wait for things that are still growing (up to 20 minutes). Amethyst: only full clusters are picked, and budding amethyst is never broken.
- Android Workbench: crafts four times as fast as a vanilla crafting table. When crafted items do not fit in the android's inventory, they go into the workbench's holding box instead of onto the ground, and the android comes back for them (right-click to take anything left behind). While the holding box has items, one of them floats above the workbench.
guide.singulo.androids.farm.body.translation:
・農活：收穫（收取成熟的作物並補種。甘蔗和仙人掌保留根部）、伐木（整棵砍樹並補種樹苗。需要伐木升級）、繁殖（餵食增加到設定數量）、剪毛・擠奶（會帶上空桶）、處理（超過設定數量的部分）。不會碰有名字、拴著、被馴服的動物和幼崽。
・操作：使用拉桿（開・關・切換）、按鈕、門等。用來驅動機關。
・液體與氣體：資材口和指令台旁的儲罐也是資材存放處。在加工模式或步驟的樣本欄中用桶等容器點擊，或用 JEI 的「+」，即可放置流體（滾輪每次 100 mB，Shift 每次 1000 mB）。裝有儲罐升級的仿生人會把流體運到裝置。製作流體的訂單會放入資材存放處的儲罐。
・燃料：在加工模式的燃料欄放入燃料後記錄，裝置燃料耗盡時會從資材存放處取來該燃料放入（每次按設定的數量，或用欄下方的按鈕設為「加滿」則帶來裝置能放入的量。兩種都不會帶來放不下的部分。留空則不去取）。資材存放處沒有且有配方可以製作時，會自動下單製作燃料（製作期間仿生人會做其他作業）。
・機率產出：產出數量不足時，從資材存放處取用不足部分的材料，重複製作直到收集齊（材料不足時會等到備齊）。收穫、伐木、牧場中若還有會生長的東西，會等待其生長（最多 20 分鐘）。紫水晶只收取完全長成的晶簇，不會破壞紫水晶母岩。
・仿生人工作台：製作速度是原版工作台的 4 倍。做出的物品裝不進仿生人的物品欄時，不會掉在腳下，而是放進作業台的暫存箱，之後再來取（取不了的物品可以右鍵取出）。暫存箱裡有物品時，工作台上方會浮現其中一件。

guide.singulo.androids.first.body.source:
The shortest way to try work automation (having bread made):
1. Print one guard at a station.
2. Place an Android Work Console, a Recipe Rack and a crafting table nearby, and a chest with wheat next to the console (the stockpile).
3. Shift-right-click the console with a Work Location Card to record it, then right-click the Recipe Rack with that card to link it.
4. Shift-right-click the crafting table with another Work Location Card and put it on the left of a rack row.
5. In the console's Record tab, put three wheat in one row of the 3x3, record it on a Recipe Card and put the card on the right of the rack row.
6. In the Order tab, pick bread, set a count and start. The bread arrives in the console's delivery box.
The order screen: click the search box to type (type @ and a mod name to show only that mod's items). There are sort and reverse buttons, and a toggle to sync with JEI's search box. With androids set to automatic, it calls just as many as the order needs.
guide.singulo.androids.first.body.translation:
用最少的步驟試試作業自動化的例子（讓它做麵包）：
1. 在組裝站列印 1 個護衛。
2. 在附近放置仿生人作業指令台、配方架和工作台，在指令台旁邊放一個裝著小麥的箱子（資材存放處）。
3. 用作業位置卡潛行右鍵指令台進行記錄，再用這張卡右鍵配方架把它們連起來。
4. 用另一張作業位置卡潛行右鍵工作台進行記錄，放在配方架一行的左邊。
5. 在指令台的「記錄」中，在 3×3 的橫向一行放 3 個小麥，記錄到配方卡上，放在配方架那一行的右邊。
6. 在「訂單」中選擇麵包，決定數量後開始作業。做好的麵包會送到指令台的交貨箱。
訂單介面：點擊搜尋欄就能輸入文字（輸入 @ 後接模組名，只顯示該模組的物品）。還有排序和倒序按鈕，以及是否與 JEI 搜尋欄同步的開關。把仿生人設為自動時，只會依訂單所需的數量選擇並召集。

guide.singulo.androids.gear.body.source:
- The button left of the name in the android screen opens the "Gear and inventory" page, where upgrades go.
- Battery Upgrade: each adds 50% to the full charge (up to two); a full recharge takes that much longer. A battery pack appears on the waist.
- Backpack Upgrades: add backpack slots to the 5-slot inventory. There are three tiers: Backpack 12, Reinforced Backpack 18 and Large Backpack 24 slots, each made from the tier below. A backpack cannot be removed while it holds items, but you can swap in a larger one whose slots still fit the contents.
- Mining Upgrade: lets the android do mining work (like a diamond pickaxe). Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
- Felling Upgrade: lets the android fell trees (like a diamond axe). Takes Efficiency, Fortune and Silk Touch.
- Tank Upgrade: two tanks for liquids and gases (32,000 mB each, one fluid per tank), shown at the waist. It cannot be removed while they hold anything. Click a tank in the screen with a bucket or other container to fill or draw; shift-click the × beside it to dump the contents.
- Gas Tank Upgrade and Gas & Liquid Upgrade (only with Mekanism installed): tanks for Mekanism chemicals (gases, infuse types, pigments, slurries). The Gas Tank holds two chemicals (32,000 mB each); the Gas & Liquid holds two liquids and two chemicals (16,000 mB each). Gas cylinders show at the waist. Click a tank in the screen with a chemical tank to fill or draw. For work, chemical tanks next to a supply port join the stockpile and androids carry chemicals to machines.
- Work on/off: choose for each android whether it may be given work (automation).
- Sort and put away: the buttons at the top right of the backpack area sort the inventory and backpack, or send the android to put them in a nearby box (a chest, barrel, shulker box or supply port within 12 blocks).
guide.singulo.androids.gear.body.translation:
- 在仿生人介面中點擊名字左邊的按鈕，切換到「裝備與物品」頁，就能放入升級。
- 電池升級：每個使充滿電量增加 50%（最多兩個），充滿所需時間也相應變長。腰部會出現電池包。
- 背包升級：在 5 格物品之外加上背包的格子。共 3 個等級：背包 12 格、強化背包 18 格、大型背包 24 格，每級都用低一級的背包製作。背包裡有物品時無法取下，但可以直接換成裝得下這些物品的更大背包。
- 採掘升級：使仿生人能進行採掘作業（相當於鑽石鎬）。可附上效率、幸運和絲綢之觸。
- 伐木升級：使仿生人能進行伐木作業（相當於鑽石斧）。可附上效率、幸運和絲綢之觸。
- 儲罐升級：2 個可裝液體或氣體的儲罐（各 32,000 mB，每個儲罐一種）。腰部會出現儲罐。儲罐裡還有東西時無法取下。用桶等點擊介面中的儲罐可以取放，按住 Shift 點擊旁邊的 × 會倒掉內容物。
- 氣體儲罐升級・氣體與液體升級（僅在安裝了 Mekanism 時）：可搬運 Mekanism 化學品（氣體、灌注物、顏料、漿液）的儲罐。氣體儲罐可裝 2 種化學品（各 32,000 mB），氣體與液體可裝液體和化學品各 2 種（各 16,000 mB）。腰部會出現氣瓶。用化學品儲罐等點擊介面中的儲罐可以取放。作業時，資材口旁的化學品儲罐會成為資材存放處，仿生人會把化學品運到裝置。
- 作業開/關：為每個仿生人決定是否可以分配作業（自動化）。
- 整理・存放：背包欄右上角的按鈕可以整理攜帶物品和背包內的物品，或讓仿生人走去把它們放進附近的箱子（12 格以內的箱子、木桶、界伏盒、資材口）。

guide.singulo.androids.glass.body.source:
- Android Barrier Glass (amber): only androids cannot pass; players and other creatures go straight through. Good for doorways.
- Android Gate Glass (cyan): only androids can pass; solid glass for everything else. Good for a guard's own path.
Androids also plan their paths around it: barrier glass counts as blocked, gate glass as open. The plain kinds join seamlessly with the same glass next to them, and four plain panes make the patterned kind.
guide.singulo.androids.glass.body.translation:
- 仿生人阻隔玻璃（琥珀色）：只有仿生人無法通過，玩家和其他生物可以直接穿過。適合放在基地出入口。
- 仿生人透過玻璃（水色）：只有仿生人可以通過，對其他一切都是實心玻璃。適合作為護衛的專用通道。
仿生人在規劃路線時也會考慮這些玻璃：阻隔玻璃視為阻擋，透過玻璃視為通路。素面款與相同的玻璃相鄰時會無縫相連，四塊素面款可以做成花紋款。

guide.singulo.androids.patrol.body.source:
Set the station's mode to Patrol and the androids walk a set route and keep watch.
- Route: choosing Patrol shows eight slots. Put Work Location Cards in them and the androids visit those places from left to right, standing on top of each to look around. Choose whether they go back to the first point (Loop) or return the same way (Back & forth), whether they patrol only at night, and how long they stop at each point. Two androids start from opposite sides.
- Fights: they fight enemies nearby and carry on from where they left off. When a fight starts, idle androids of the same station come to help (and go back afterwards).
- Alarm: when they spot a group of enemies (5 or more) or a boss, the station gives a redstone signal for 5 seconds and the owner is told (at most once a minute).
- Log: defeated enemies and alarms are kept on the Log page of the android screen, newest first (16 entries). Come back after a while and the android tells you what happened while you were away.
guide.singulo.androids.patrol.body.translation:
把組裝站的行動方式設為「巡邏」後，仿生人會按順序巡視設定的地點並警戒。
・巡邏路線：選擇「巡邏」後會出現 8 個欄位，放入作業位置卡後，會從左到右依次巡視這些地點，站在卡片記錄的地點上方環顧四周。可以選擇到達最後後回到第一個地點（循環）還是沿原路返回（往返）、是否只在夜間巡邏，以及在每個地點停留的時間。兩個仿生人會從相反的方向開始巡視。
・戰鬥：與附近的敵人戰鬥，解決後從離開的地方繼續。開始戰鬥時會呼叫同一組裝站空閒的同伴（解決後回到原來的崗位）。
・警報：發現敵人群體（5 個以上）或首領時，組裝站會發出 5 秒紅石訊號並通知主人（每分鐘最多 1 次）。
・記錄：擊倒的敵人和警報會按從新到舊的順序記在仿生人介面的「記錄」頁（16 條）。隔一段時間再走近時，它會告訴你不在時發生的事。

guide.singulo.androids.process.body.source:
The mode button in the console's Record tab switches what you record.
- Processing: furnace and machine recipes. Put what goes in on the left and what comes out on the right (plus up to two byproducts), and scroll to change counts (JEI's + button works too). Androids put the items in and take the results out (the faces are chosen automatically, or set them with the In and Out buttons when recording). While a slow machine works, they do other jobs (including their other orders) and come back when it is done. Byproducts go back to the stockpile. Provide fuel or power yourself. If nothing happens for two minutes, the order is cancelled.
- Procedure: record up to eight insert, extract and mine steps on a Procedure Card. Place a Work Location Card to copy the place, put the item in the item slot and press Add. Put the product on the right and record. Procedure cards hold their own places, so they work in any recipe rack row.
- Mining: only androids with a Mining Upgrade do it. Two Work Location Cards mark an area; it is dug from the top layer down until enough of the wanted item is collected (it works with a cobblestone generator too). Unbreakable blocks, liquids, containers and shield-protected places are skipped. If there is nothing to dig for 30 seconds, the order is cancelled.
guide.singulo.androids.process.body.translation:
用指令台「記錄」的模式按鈕切換要記錄的種類。
・加工：熔爐和裝置的配方。左邊放放入的物品，右邊放產出的物品（另可放最多 2 個副產物），用滾輪變更數量（也可用 JEI 的「+」）。仿生人把材料放入裝置，取出產物（面會自動決定，也可以在記錄時用「入」「出」按鈕指定）。耗時較長的加工，會在等待期間去做其他作業（包括承擔的其他訂單），完成後再回來取。副產物放回資材存放處。燃料和電力需自己準備。2 分鐘沒有進展時，訂單會被取消。
・步驟：在步驟卡上記錄最多 8 個放入、取出、採掘的步驟。放入作業位置卡來複製位置，在物品欄放入物品後按「新增」。在右邊放產物後記錄。步驟卡自帶位置，所以可以放在配方架的任意一行。
・採掘：只有裝有採掘升級的仿生人會執行。用 2 張作業位置卡決定範圍後，從上層開始挖，直到收集到所需物品（也可用於刷石機）。無法破壞的方塊、液體、容器、受護盾保護的地方不會挖。沒有可挖的東西持續 30 秒時會取消。

guide.singulo.androids.routes.body.source:
On the Routes page of the work console, and the Routes page of the assembly station (the button right of the title), you can set up to four movement rules (the console's apply to work trips, the station's to patrols).
- Each row takes a waypoint (Work Location Card), an area (Area Card) and up to two no-entry zones (Area Cards).
- Moving into or out of the area, androids first pass over the waypoint, like a door to the base, and stay out of the no-entry zones on the way (unless they start or end inside one).
- Area Card: sneak-use two blocks to record the area between them as corners (up to 128 blocks per side). Areas reach from the recorded height up two blocks, so recording floor blocks works for androids walking on them.
- Survey Glasses: worn on the head, they outline the places recorded on the area or work location card in your hand (with only the first corner recorded, the area up to the block you look at is previewed). The icons over working androids only show while you wear them.
guide.singulo.androids.routes.body.translation:
在作業指令台的「路徑」頁和組裝站的「路徑」（標題右邊的按鈕）中，最多可以設定 4 條仿生人的移動規則（作業指令台作用於作業的移動，組裝站作用於巡邏的移動）。
・每一行放入途經點（作業位置卡）、對象範圍（範圍卡）、禁入區域（範圍卡，最多 2 個）。
・進出對象範圍的移動，會先經過途經點上方再前往目的地（像據點的門一樣）。途中不會進入禁入區域（出發地或目的地在區域內時，不避開該區域）。
・範圍卡：潛行右鍵兩個方塊，記錄以它們為角的範圍（每邊最多 128 格）。範圍作用於從記錄方塊的高度到其上 2 格，所以記錄地面方塊，就能作用於在上面行走的仿生人。
・測量眼鏡：戴在頭上時，手中範圍卡・作業位置卡記錄的地點會以框線顯示（範圍卡只記錄了第一個角時，還會預覽到所看方塊為止的範圍）。作業中仿生人頭上的標記，也只有戴著時才能看到。

guide.singulo.androids.ruin.body.source:
Every ruin has Ruin Android Fabricators against its walls. When a survival player comes near, a fabricator prints two or three androids of its kind (Blade, Whip or Saber) onto its bed, built up from the feet, and sends them out. Defeat them all and, half the time, a compact crystal memory of that design appears on the fabricator. Either way, the fabricator then rests for a day.
- Blade Android "Lumina": when she crouches and her blade flares, she dashes in leaving afterimages and slashes. When she kneels and touches the floor, rings appear at your feet and pillars of light rise (step out of the rings). Up close she spins with her blade spread.
- Whip Android "Verna": a lash that reaches about 6 blocks and a bind that wraps and pulls you in. When she twirls the whip overhead, she slams the floor and sends a straight shockwave (jump it).
- Saber Android "Soleil": a lunging thrust, a sweep whose blade stretches as she swings, and a flying crescent slash. When hit she raises a light shield in front (little gets through from the front) and counters if you keep striking it. Attack from the side or behind.
The Android Laboratory holds prototypes that fabricators never print (its overseer calls them).
- Axe Android "Alma": tough and heavy. When she draws the axe back to the right, a wide cleave follows; raised overhead, she slams the floor and sends a straight shockwave ahead (jump it); crouched low, she leaps in and strikes all around where she lands.
- Bit Android "Nox": she floats the bits from her back and shoots you with beams from range (six bits below half health). She keeps her distance; get close and she stabs twice with a dagger, then hops back. When a blade lights up at a bit’s tip, the bit itself lunges at the marked position. Dodge sideways during the windup; walls stop both beams and lunges.
Androids run on charge. After about ten big moves they run out and their eyes go dark. They return to a nearby fabricator, or unfold a solar panel under the open daytime sky, or sit down at night or indoors to recharge (fabricator 5 s, solar 10 s, sitting 14 s). They do not attack while charging: your chance to strike.
guide.singulo.androids.ruin.body.translation:
每座遺蹟的牆邊都有廢墟仿生人列印台。生存模式的玩家靠近時，它會在台面上從腳開始逐層列印出 2〜3 個對應型號（光刃型、鞭型或光劍型）的仿生人並讓其出動。全部擊敗後，台面上有一半的機率出現該型號的小型水晶記憶體。無論是否出現，列印台隨後都會休息一天。
- 光刃型「露米娜」：蹲下、刀刃發亮後，會留下殘影衝來斬擊。單膝跪地手按地面時，腳下會出現預告圈並升起光柱（離開圈）。近身時會張開刀刃迴旋斬。
- 鞭型「薇爾娜」：可達約 6 格的鞭擊，以及纏住並把你拉近的纏繞。在頭頂甩鞭後，會抽打地面放出一道直線衝擊波（跳起即可躲開）。
- 光劍型「索蕾伊」：踏步突刺、揮動時劍刃伸長的橫斬，以及飛行的新月斬擊波。受擊時會在正面展開光盾（正面幾乎打不進去），繼續攻擊會被反擊。請從側面或背後進攻。
地下仿生人研究所裡有列印台不會出現的試作機（由統籌 AI 呼叫）。
- 斧型「阿爾瑪」：又硬又重。把斧頭往右拉之後是大範圍橫掃；舉過頭頂後會砸向地面，向前方放出一道直線衝擊波（跳起來就不會被打中）；壓低身體後會撲過來，落地時攻擊周圍。
- 浮游砲型「諾克絲」：讓背上的浮游砲浮起來，從遠處用光線射擊（體力低於一半時增至 6 台）。她會試圖拉開距離，靠近時會用短劍連擊兩次再向後跳開。躲到牆後光線就打不到。
仿生人依靠電量行動，大招用 10 次左右就會耗盡，眼睛的光會熄滅。它們會回到附近的列印台，或在白天露天處展開太陽能板，夜晚或室內則坐下充電（列印台 5 秒、太陽能 10 秒、坐下 14 秒）。充電時不會攻擊，正是進攻的時機。
位元尖端出現光刃後，位元本身會衝向預先瞄準的位置。準備動作時向側面閃避；牆壁能擋住光束與突進。

guide.singulo.androids.trouble.body.source:
When an android is stuck, you can see why in these places:
- The status page of the android screen: the reason appears in red in the speech bubble.
- Order details in the Work Console: it appears next to the assigned android's name.
- With Survey Glasses on, a barrier icon floats over a stuck android's head.
Reasons and fixes:
- The station is out of power: add generation or check the cable to the station.
- Can't reach the destination: check that steps, doors or water don't cut the path, and that a route rule (no-go zone) doesn't block it.
- Not enough materials in the stockpile: add materials to the chests beside the supply port or the console. Intermediate materials are crafted if there is a recipe.
- A protected block: a shield or another mod's protection stops it. Check that the person who placed the order may break it.
- Nothing to work on in the area: check the Work Location Card area. Waiting for crops to grow does not count as stuck (clock icon).
- Storage is full: empty the delivery port or stockpile chests.
When an order is cancelled, the console shows why (unreachable, recipe doesn't match, no progress for a long time, or the wrong input face).
guide.singulo.androids.trouble.body.translation:
仿生人停下來時，可以在以下地方確認原因。
・仿生人介面的狀態頁：對話氣泡中會用紅字顯示原因。
・作業指令台的訂單詳情：顯示在負責的仿生人名字旁邊。
・戴上測量眼鏡後，停下的仿生人頭上會出現禁止通行的標誌。
原因與解決方法：
・組裝站電力不足：增加發電，或檢查連到組裝站的線纜。
・無法到達目的地：檢查道路是否被台階、門或水阻斷，以及路線規則（禁入區域）是否擋住了路。
・資材存放處的材料不足：往資材口或指令台旁邊的箱子裡補充材料。中間材料只要有配方就會自己製作。
・受保護的方塊：因護盾或其他模組的保護而無法破壞。確認下訂單的人是否有破壞的權限。
・作業範圍內沒有對象：重新檢查作業位置卡的範圍。等待作物生長時不算停下（時鐘標誌）。
・存放處已滿：清空交付口或資材存放處的箱子。
訂單被取消時，指令台會顯示原因（無法到達、配方不符、長時間沒有進展、投入面不對）。

guide.singulo.androids.upgrades.body.source:
- Production Upgrade: fitted in the station, it prints and looks after up to two androids. Only one charges on top at a time; the other waits beside it and takes its turn. Use "1" and "2" left of the name to choose which android the screen shows (settings are shared).
- Factory Print Unit: in the slot beside the station's kit slot, it halves printing time and power and doubles repair speed on the station. Made from precision actuators found in the Underground Android Laboratory.
guide.singulo.androids.upgrades.body.translation:
- 生產升級：裝在組裝站後，最多列印並管理兩個仿生人。一次只能有一個在上方充電，另一個在旁邊等待並輪流。用名字左邊的「1」「2」選擇介面顯示哪一個（行動方式等設定兩個共用）。
- 工廠式列印單元：裝在組裝站套件旁邊的槽中，列印所需的時間和電力減半，在組裝站上的修理速度變為 2 倍。用地下仿生人研究所中取得的精密致動器製作。

guide.singulo.androids.work.body.source:
Your androids can take over crafting table work.
1. Place an Android Work Console and sneak-use a Work Location Card on it to record it. Use that card on recipe racks (and extra supply ports and delivery ports) to link them to the console (within 64 blocks).
2. Put chests next to the console (or a supply port) as the stockpile. Androids go round the places that actually hold the materials. Finished orders go to the destination chosen in the order: the console's outbox or a named delivery port.
3. In the console's Record tab, lay out a 3×3 pattern (nothing is used up; JEI's + button works too) and record it onto a recipe card.
4. In a recipe rack row, put a Work Location Card holding a crafting table on the left and the recipe cards on the right.
5. In the console's Order tab, pick an item and amount, check the materials are in stock, choose androids and press Start. Intermediate materials are crafted too when there is a recipe for them.
- New: when on, finished items already in storage are not used and the whole amount is crafted new (for example, with 3 iron axes in storage, order 2 to get 2 more).
- In the Order tab, items being made have an orange frame. The ↻ button on a running order orders the same item again. An order waiting for materials shows what is missing and how many (hover over the row for the full list).
- Orders placed from the screen send the orderer a chat message when they finish, when they have been stuck waiting for materials for a minute, or when they are cancelled.
Androids carry 5 slots at a time (+12, 18 or 24 with a backpack). You cannot take items from a working android; when the order is done it goes back to its usual mode. A working android can also take on more orders from the same console and works on them when it is free. If a place cannot be reached, the order is cancelled.
guide.singulo.androids.work.body.translation:
可以把工作台的合成交給自己的仿生人。
1. 放置仿生人作業指令台，用作業位置卡潛行右鍵來記錄它。用這張卡右鍵配方架（要增加的話還有資材口和交付口），就會連接到指令台（64 格以內）。
2. 在指令台（和資材口）旁邊放箱子（資材存放處）。仿生人會到實際放有材料的地方去取。成品會送到下單時選擇的交付目標（指令台的交付箱或命名過的交付口）。
3. 在指令台的「記錄」的 3×3 中擺放樣本（物品不會減少，也可用 JEI 的「+」），記錄到配方卡上。
4. 在配方架某一行的左邊放記錄了工作台的作業位置卡，右邊排列配方卡。
5. 在指令台的「訂單」中選擇物品和數量，確認材料足夠，選擇仿生人後開始作業。有配方的中間材料也會自己製作。
- 「新做」：開啟後，不使用庫存中的成品，而是新做訂購的數量（例如有 3 把鐵斧、還想要 2 把時，訂購「2」）。
- 在訂單列表中，正在製作的物品會帶有橙色邊框。進行中訂單的「↻」可以再次訂購同一物品。等待材料的訂單會顯示缺少的物品和數量（把游標移到該行可看到全部）。
- 從畫面下達的訂單在完成時、等待材料停止超過 1 分鐘時、被取消時，會在聊天欄通知下單的人。
仿生人每次搬運 5 格（有背包時 +12、18 或 24）。作業中無法取出它的物品，訂單完成後會回到原來的行動方式。作業中的仿生人也可以承擔同一指令台的其他訂單（空閒時也會去做）。有無法到達的地方時，該訂單會被取消。

guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body.source:
Machines that use catalysts have a dedicated slot that accepts only catalysts (the slot marked with a catalyst icon). Nothing else fits.
A used-up catalyst becomes a spent catalyst. In the Catalytic Reactor, about 25% of it can be recovered as material for the catalyst one tier lower.
guide.singulo.catalysts.slots.body.translation:
使用催化劑的裝置有只能放入催化劑的專用槽（介面中帶有催化劑標記的格子），其他物品放不進去。
用盡的催化劑會變成失活催化劑。在催化反應器中，約 25% 可回收為低一級催化劑的材料。

guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body.source:
Muon (2), BE condensate (3), time crystal (4), Singularity Core (5).
- Same tier as the machine: standard
- One tier higher: speed +25%, wear −20% (stacks up to two tiers higher)
- One tier lower: ×0.5 speed, ×2 wear (generators run at 25% of their rated output)
- Two tiers lower: unusable
As a catalyst wears down, the power it needs rises (up to ×1.6); below 80% power, incomplete reactions make it wear ×1.5 faster.
These rules apply to devices that run on a catalyst slot (anchors, stabilizers, generators, shields and so on). When a processing recipe lists a catalyst as an ingredient, it uses a fixed count or amount of life and the speed does not change (for example, a BE condensate catalyst takes one muon catalyst and 40 seconds).
guide.singulo.catalysts.tiers.body.translation:
緲子（2）、玻色凝聚態（3）、時間晶體（4）、奇點核心（5）。
- 與裝置同級：標準
- 高一級：速度 +25%，消耗 −20%（最多疊加到高兩級）
- 低一級：速度 ×0.5，消耗 ×2（發電機輸出為額定的 25%）
- 低兩級：無法使用
剩餘越少，所需電力越多（最多 ×1.6）；電力低於 80% 時會因反應不完全而使消耗 ×1.5。
這些規則適用於靠催化劑槽運轉的裝置（錨、穩定器、發電機、護盾等）。加工配方中作為材料列出的催化劑，只消耗固定數量或壽命，速度不變（例如：玻色凝聚態催化劑的加工需要 1 個緲子催化劑，耗時 40 秒）。

guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.source: In a P-Reactor's pull zone time slows down: catalysts wear at ×0.5 (machines run at ×0.8). Inside a T-Cylinder field it is the reverse, ×2. The two cancel out where they overlap. Keeping catalyst storage near the reactor makes them last longer.
guide.singulo.catalysts.time.body.translation: 彭羅斯反應爐的引力區內時間變慢：催化劑消耗為 ×0.5（裝置為 ×0.8）。蒂普勒圓柱的範圍內則相反，為 ×2。兩者重疊時會互相抵消。把催化劑倉庫放在爐旁能用得更久。

guide.singulo.genesis.birth.body.source:
1. Kindling: pour in 1.5 TFE (at most 1 GFE per tick) — a little over a minute at full P-Reactor output.
2. Stabilizing: hold 100 MFE/t for about four minutes of active progress (it pauses while the feed is stopped or power runs short, so expect a little longer). Now and then a surge alarm sounds: stop the feed while it lasts (the switch on the screen that opens when you use the core empty-handed, or a redstone signal). Keep feeding and instability spikes; at 100% the proto-universe collapses and progress is lost. Upkeep still drains the buffer and events still happen while stopped. Watch out for gravity leaks, echoes and gravity waves. A shield softens surges and events; a T-Cylinder field speeds things up.
3. Birth: the light falls into a point and a universe is born. Its galaxy rises into the overworld night sky.
Use the core empty-handed to open its screen: stage, progress, instability and input.
guide.singulo.genesis.birth.body.translation:
1. 種火：注入 1.5 TFE（每 tick 最多 1 GFE）。彭羅斯反應爐全力運轉約需一分多鐘。
2. 穩定化：維持 100 MFE/t，實際推進約 4 分鐘（停止投料或電力不足時不會推進，所以實際會稍久一些）。期間會不時響起「失控徵兆」警報，警報持續時請停止投料（空手對核心使用開啟介面並按下開關，或對核心給予紅石訊號）。若持續投料，不穩定度會急遽上升，到達 100% 時即將誕生的宇宙會崩塌，進度倒退。停止投料期間，儲能仍會被維持電力消耗，事件也照樣發生。也要留意重力外洩、記錄的殘響與引力之波。在護盾範圍內，失控與事件會減弱；在蒂普勒圓柱的加速場內，進度會加快。
3. 誕生：光墜向一點，宇宙隨之誕生。誕生的銀河會升上主世界的夜空。
空手對核心使用會開啟介面，可查看階段、進度、不穩定度與受電。

guide.singulo.genesis.build.body.source:
The old civilization fell trying to turn all mass into energy. The Genesis Engine does the reverse.
- Eight Genesis Frames level with the core: three blocks out on each axis, and two-and-two on each diagonal.
- Three Genesis Pylons stacked on each of the four diagonal frames (twelve in all).
The core chimes when formed. Use a Primordial Seed on it to begin. Power enters from any side.
guide.singulo.genesis.build.body.translation:
舊文明試圖將「所有質量化為能量」而走向滅亡。創世爐正好相反，是以能量孕育宇宙的爐。
- 在核心周圍同一高度放置 8 個創世爐框架：十字方向距核心 3 格處 4 個，斜向 2 格 × 2 格處 4 個。
- 在 4 個斜向框架上各疊 3 層創世爐支柱（共 12 根）。
成形時核心會發出聲響。對核心使用原初之種即可開始（需要漩渦斷章）。電力可從任何一面輸入。

guide.singulo.genesis.synth.body.source:
A Genesis Engine that has given birth can make items from power. Use the core empty-handed to open its screen and put the item you want in the left frame (or use the item on the core). Collect results from the slot on the right (or pull them from below with a hopper).
Cost per item = mass × 1 GFE × 10^rarity. Rarity runs from 0 (stone, dirt) to 4 (nether star, elytra, dragon egg), so rarer items cost orders of magnitude more power. A broken core keeps the memory of its universe and works again wherever you place it, but stored power and partial progress are lost, so do not break it in the middle of an expensive item. The list of items is a datapack (mass_synthesis).
guide.singulo.genesis.synth.body.translation:
誕生了宇宙的創世爐能將電力轉化為物品。空手使用核心開啟介面，把想製造的物品登記到左側框中（手持物品對核心使用也可登記）。完成的物品可從介面右側的欄位取出（也可用漏斗等從下方抽出）。
每個物品的電力 = 質量 × 1 GFE × 10^稀有度。稀有度從 0（石頭、泥土等）到 4（地獄之星、鞘翅、龍蛋等），越稀有的物品耗電量高出好幾個數量級。拆下的核心會保留宇宙的記憶，放到別處後仍可直接使用（但儲存的電力與未完成的進度不會保留，製造昂貴物品途中請勿拆除）。可製造的物品由資料包（mass_synthesis）定義。

guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.source:
- The reactor's tidal zone (radius 4) deals damage that ignores armour.
- A broken hydrogen container causes a small explosion near fire.
- A large particle accelerator may occasionally leak a strangelet, which turns one nearby block per second into strange matter (it stops at radius 8 or 512 blocks and does not spread inside a shield). Contain and collect it with a Magnetic Bottle.
guide.singulo.hazards.list.body.translation:
- 反應爐的潮汐區（半徑 4）造成的傷害會無視護甲。
- 氫氣容器損壞時，若靠近火源會發生小型爆炸。
- 大規模運轉的粒子加速器偶爾會洩漏奇異子，每秒把附近 1 個方塊轉化為奇異夸克物質方塊（到半徑 8 或 512 個方塊為止，不會擴散進護盾內）。可用磁瓶將其封存並回收。

guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.source:
Power (FE) travels through Singulo cables; items and fluids use per-side settings and other mods' pipes. Without pipes, right-click machines with a Fluid Canister (1,000 mB) to carry liquids and gases.
From stage 2 you use catalysts: consumables with a lifetime, placed in a dedicated catalyst slot. One tier above the machine is faster; one below is slower and wears faster; two below cannot be used.
Ancient ruins hold records and parts you cannot craft. Start looking for Observation Posts early.
guide.singulo.intro.basics.body.translation:
電力（FE）透過 Singulo 的電纜傳輸；物品與流體則透過裝置各面的設定與其他模組的管線傳輸。沒有管線時，拿著流體罐（1,000 mB）右鍵機器即可搬運液體與氣體。
從第 2 階段開始會用到催化劑：有壽命的消耗品，放在專用的催化劑槽中。等級比裝置高一級時速度較快；低一級時速度較慢且消耗較快；低兩級則無法使用。
古代廢墟中保存著無法製作的記錄與零件。及早開始尋找地表觀測站吧。

guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.source:
- Pick a chapter on the left to show its pages on the right. Turn pages with the arrows at the bottom.
- The Progress chapter follows industry, exploration and android branches and shows completed and upcoming goals (the same as the Singulo tab of the advancements screen, L key).
- Hover over an item for its description; hold Shift to see how it is made and what it is used for.
- Hover over a Singulo item and press H to open the page about it (or press H while holding it). Type in the search box above the chapter list to find matching pages.
- Use the Holo Projector on a multiblock controller to show the correct shape as a translucent outline.
guide.singulo.intro.howto.body.translation:
- 選擇左側的章節，右側會顯示頁面。用下方的箭頭翻頁。
- 「進度」章節會顯示已達成與下一個目標（與進度畫面〔L 鍵〕的 Singulo 分頁相同）。
- 將滑鼠移到物品上可查看說明；按住 Shift 可查看製作方式與用途。
- 把游標移到 Singulo 的物品上並按 H 鍵，會打開介紹該物品的頁面（手持時也可以）。在章節列表上方的搜尋框輸入文字，可以查找相關頁面。
- 對多方塊結構的控制器使用全像投影器，正確的形狀會以半透明方式浮現。
進度按工業、探索與機器人分支展示；連線用於引導，不是額外的解鎖條件。

guide.singulo.intro.vanilla.body.source:
Machines can make these vanilla materials, so you can skip some hunting and travel.
- Compressor (stage 1): cobblestone to gravel to sand, sandstone to 2 sand. 4 snow blocks to ice, 4 ice to packed ice, 4 packed ice to blue ice. Calcite to limestone powder (instead of bone meal), 3 charcoal to 2 carbon dust (instead of coal). Iron and gold tools and armor to nuggets (about two thirds of the ingots).
- Kiln (stage 1): unfired phosphor (zinc dust + copper + gunpowder) to 4 glowstone dust.
- Peltier Cooler (stage 1): water to ice.
- Cryogenic Cooling Tower (stage 2): water + liquid nitrogen to packed ice, lava + liquid nitrogen to obsidian. Cryo-milling turns a bone into 6 bone meal, a blaze rod into 4 powder and wool into 4 string.
- Catalytic Reactor (stage 2): sand + water to nether quartz.
- Entanglement Synthesizer (stage 3): entangled element + slime ball to ender pearl.
- Particle Accelerator (stage 3): bismuth ingot + carbon dust to a gold ingot.
- Degenerate Compactor (stage 4): 8 coal blocks to a diamond.
- Time Crystal Incubator (stage 4): logs to coal, cobblestone to mossy cobblestone, copper block to oxidized copper.
guide.singulo.intro.vanilla.body.translation:
這些原版材料可以用裝置製作，省去一些狩獵和遠行。
・壓縮機（第 1 階段）：鵝卵石→礫石→沙，砂岩→沙×2。雪塊×4→冰，冰×4→冰塊，冰塊×4→藍冰。方解石→石灰粉（代替骨粉），木炭×3→碳粉×2（代替煤炭）。鐵和金的工具、盔甲→粒（約為錠的三分之二）。
・燒製爐（第 1 階段）：未燒製螢光體（鋅粉＋銅＋火藥）→螢石粉×4。
・珀耳帖冷卻器（第 1 階段）：水→冰。
・極低溫冷卻塔（第 2 階段）：水＋液態氮→冰塊，熔岩＋液態氮→黑曜石。冷凍粉碎：骨頭→骨粉×6，烈焰桿→烈焰粉×4，羊毛→線×4。
・催化反應器（第 2 階段）：沙＋水→地獄石英。
・量子糾纏合成器（第 3 階段）：量子糾纏元件＋史萊姆球→終界珍珠。
・粒子加速器（第 3 階段）：鉍錠＋碳粉→金錠。
・簡併壓縮爐（第 4 階段）：煤炭方塊×8→鑽石。
・時間晶體培育槽（第 4 階段）：原木→煤炭，鵝卵石→青苔鵝卵石，銅方塊→氧化銅方塊。

guide.singulo.intro.vanilla.title.translation: 用裝置製作的原版材料

guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.source:
Singulo is a tech mod about extracting energy from mass. Start with thermoelectric power, build up cryogenic, quantum and temporal technology stage by stage, and finally generate power from a spinning black hole (the P-Reactor).
There are five stages. Each has a goal machine and a key material that opens the next stage. Read from "Stage 1" on the left to know what to build next.
guide.singulo.intro.welcome.body.translation:
Singulo 是一個「從質量中提取能量」的科技模組。從熱電發電起步，逐步累積低溫、量子與時間技術，最後以旋轉的黑洞（彭羅斯反應爐）發電。
共有五個階段。每個階段都有目標裝置，以及通往下一階段的關鍵材料。從左側的「第 1 階段」開始依序閱讀，就能知道接下來該建造什麼。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.source:
- Cryogenic Cooling Tower (5×5, 7–15 high): cooling_tower
- Particle Accelerator (ring 8–32 wide): particle_accelerator
- Degenerate Compactor (5×5×5): degenerate_compactor
- C-Cavity (5×5×5): casimir_cavity
- Degenerate Furnace (5×5×7): degenerate_furnace
- P-Reactor (13×13×13): penrose_reactor
- Event Horizon Shield Tower (5×5, 9 high): event_horizon_shield
- T-Cylinder (5×5×9): tipler_cylinder
- Wormhole Generator (5×5×5 sphere): wormhole_generator
guide.singulo.multiblocks.list.body.translation:
- 低溫冷卻塔（5×5，高 7–15）：cooling_tower
- 粒子加速器（環邊長 8–32）：particle_accelerator
- 簡併壓縮爐（5×5×5）：degenerate_compactor
- 卡西米爾腔（5×5×5）：casimir_cavity
- 簡併熱爐（5×5×7）：degenerate_furnace
- 彭羅斯反應爐（13×13×13）：penrose_reactor
- 事件視界護盾塔（5×5，高 9）：event_horizon_shield
- 蒂普勒圓柱（5×5×9）：tipler_cylinder
- 蟲洞產生器（5×5×5 球體）：wormhole_generator

guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.source:
1. Place the controller (its front faces you and the structure extends behind it).
2. Right-click the controller with the Holo Projector. The correct shape is projected, and the required and missing counts appear in chat.
3. Place the shown blocks in the cyan boxes and remove the blocks in the red ones. When everything is in place the projection disappears, light runs along the seams and the machine starts.
4. For machines with a choice of size (the cooling tower and the accelerator), sneak-use the projector to switch sizes.
In creative mode, /singulo build <name> [size] builds it in one go.
guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.body.translation:
1. 放置控制器（正面朝向自己，結構往其後方延伸）。
2. 用全像投影器右鍵控制器，正確的形狀會投影出來，所需數量與缺少的數量會顯示在聊天欄。
3. 在青色框中放入所示方塊，移除紅色框中的方塊。全部就位後投影消失，接縫處閃過光芒，裝置啟動。
4. 可選尺寸的裝置（冷卻塔、加速器）潛行使用投影器即可切換尺寸。
創造模式下可用 /singulo build <名稱> [尺寸] 一次建成。

guide.singulo.multiblocks.projector.titl.translation: 全像投影器的使用方式

guide.singulo.power.cables.body.source:
Copper wire (2 kFE/t, with losses) → superconducting cable (1 MFE/t) → topological wire (100 MFE/t) → horizon bus (no limit; up to about 2.1 GFE/t per machine from other mods). Each route is limited by its lowest-capacity cable; unrelated branches do not lower that limit. Transfers sharing a cable share its per-tick capacity.
Sources nearer to the receiver along the cables supply power first; more distant sources cover the deficit. Equal distances use a stable coordinate order. An empty nearby source or a bottleneck on its route does not block the backup sources. Breaking a cable immediately clears the glow of that wiring.
guide.singulo.power.cables.body.translation:
銅導線（2 kFE/t，有損耗）→ 超導電纜（1 MFE/t）→ 拓撲導線（100 MFE/t）→ 視界匯流排（無上限；送往其他模組的裝置每台最多約 2.1 GFE/t）。每條路徑的傳輸量由該路徑中容量最低的線纜決定，不受其他分支的限制。經過同一線纜的多次傳輸共用每刻容量。
依線纜路徑到受電裝置的距離，優先使用較近的電源，不足部分由較遠的電源補充。距離相同時依固定座標順序處理。近處電源已空或其路徑容量不足時，也會由其他電源補足。切斷線纜後，該線路的發光會立即消失。

guide.singulo.power.relocation.body.source:
Craft a Relocation Wrench from 3 steel ingots, 2 copper ingots and a basic circuit. Sneak-use it to pack processing machines, conventional generators, SMES and catalyst devices. Items, fluids, energy, progress and side settings are restored on placement. A full inventory drops one packed device on the ground.
For multiblocks only the controller is packed; the surrounding parts stay in place. Rebuild the structure after moving it. P-Reactors, wormhole devices and android facilities are not supported.
guide.singulo.power.relocation.body.translation:
用3個鋼錠、2個銅錠與1個基礎電路製作移設扳手。潛行使用可回收加工裝置、一般發電機、SMES及觸媒裝置，並在重新放置時恢復物品、流體、電力、進度與面設定。背包已滿時會掉落1個已打包的裝置。
多方塊結構只回收控制器，周圍部件留在原處；移設後需重新組裝。彭羅斯反應爐、蟲洞裝置及仿生人設施等不在支援範圍內。

guide.singulo.power.sides.body.source: Use the Sides button in an ordinary processing machine screen to set each face to off / input / output / both, with optional auto-eject. The master auto-eject switch defaults off; turn it on to push through output-capable faces with auto-eject enabled. Hover a face to see its adjacent block. Multiblocks use designated I/O ports; the P-Reactor uses Extraction Ports. Machines that output two gases, such as the electrolyzer, have a tab for each gas. The power button stops a machine, and machines that can make something from power alone have a switch to skip those recipes.
